layout: blocks per mother tongue; rows = districts and states, columns = total returning the mother-tongue and subsidiary languages x Males/Females
notes: Printed p. 287, cols 20-37. Blocks: Mother-tongue Hindustani contd. (cols 20-25: subsidiary Saurashtri, Tamil, Telugu; total-returning figures are on leaf 292) and Mother-tongue Kanarese (cols 26-37: total returning; subsidiary Hill and Aboriginal, Hindustani, Malayalam, Oriya, Saurashtri); Kanarese block probably continues on leaf 294. Only Males/Females printed. On the right half of the page the data rows sit about one line below their labels (skew); rows were assigned by counting within each printed group of 3/5 rows and confirmed by the area totals. In this scan the figure 4 prints faintly and looks like 1: Kanarese males Ganjam 44, Bellary 270,014, Tinnevelly 5,457, Nilgiris 16,426, Malabar 8,614 and Hindustani/Telugu females Madura 4 were read as 4 only after close zoom and confirmation by the British Territory totals (the Kanarese figures also agree with Part I leaf 286). With these, all area totals reconcile in every column (Ganjam Kanarese = Agency 1 + Plains 43 = 44).
